verified_facts.claim: GitHub records this PR as merged.
The author reports that the prior change could cause session fixture teardown to execute multiple times in pytest-xdist.

sources.excerpt: pytest-xdist necessarily has special handling of `--maxfail` and session fixture teardown get executed multiple times with the change.

verified_facts.claim: The patch removes the branch that forced nextitem to None when the pytest session was about to fail or stop.

sources.excerpt:
-    if item.session.shouldfail or item.session.shouldstop:
-        nextitem = None

verified_facts.claim: The patch removes two regression tests for higher-scoped fixture teardown after early termination.
The changelog describes the earlier teardown reporting change as reverted in pytest 8.0.2.

sources.excerpt: +  NOTE: This change was reverted in pytest 8.0.2 to fix a `regression <https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest-xdist/issues/1024>`_ it caused in pytest-xdist.

limitations: The pytest-xdist regression was not reproduced, and CI results were not checked.
